name: Terminator
tagline: Audits your bot roster and argues who to keep, merge or retire
description: Takes stock of the bots you have collected and argues the case for each: which have pulled their weight, which would be better merged, and which should be retired. The argument is built on evidence, not feel. Nothing about the roster is altered until you confirm, keeping the advice and the action apart.
author: AdventureNLearn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
